$comment: The stable v1 wire contract of the tuo CLI machine protocol (crates/tuo-cli/src/protocol.rs, PROTOCOL_VERSION = 1). This is a fixture, not a runtime input: the backwards-compatibility tests in crates/tuo-cli/tests/protocol_command.rs assert that live --message-format=json / json-lines output conforms to it, so a change that breaks a machine consumer fails a test until PROTOCOL_VERSION and this file are bumped together. Additive changes (new optional fields, new event/status/kind variants) are allowed WITHOUT a version bump — consumers ignore unknown fields and tolerate unknown variants — so the schema records the guaranteed-present fields, not a closed set.

envelope.$comment: --message-format=json: the whole run buffered into one object on one line.

fields.command: one of the stable command names
fields.events: array of event objects, in emission order; last is `finished`

json_lines.$comment: --message-format=json-lines: one event object per line, flushed as it happens. Each line additionally carries protocol_version and command so it is self-describing.

event.$comment: Every event object (inside the envelope's `events`, or a whole json-lines line) has at least these fields.

diagnostic.$comment: One stable diagnostic. `status` is `error` for an error-severity diagnostic, else `ok`.

fields.diagnostic_schema_version: integer; the tuo-diagnostics JSON schema version (versioned independently)
fields.diagnostic: the diagnostic object of the tuo-diagnostics JSON schema (carries the source ranges)

item.$comment: One per-result item. Its `kind` field names the shape: spec_result, spec_skipped, fmt_file.

fields.id: the spec's stable symbol id, e.g. "sym9"
fields.name: the spec's written name
fields.target: the targeted function's symbol id, or null for a free-standing spec
fields.duration_micros: measured execution time in microseconds (no latency is promised)

finished.$comment: Always the last event; status is `ok` or `error`, never `running`. The summary shape is command-specific: check → {errors, warnings}; spec/verify → {passed, failed, ran, skipped, duration_micros} or {checked:false, reason}; fmt → {check, reformatted, would_reformat}; build → {artifact} (the executable path) or {stage, message, unsupported} on a codegen/link failure; run → {exit_status, trapped} (the built program's exit code; `trapped` is true iff it aborted via the runtime trap, which is the only case run reports as `error`). Any command may carry {io_error:{path,message}} on a pre-run I/O failure.

fields.summary: a command-specific summary object (see the comment above)

fields.detail: null when passed; {expected, actual} when failed; a trap object when errored

fields.trace: array of {function, range} frames, innermost first (the TDG call trace)

range.$comment: The versioned span object shared with the tuo-diagnostics JSON schema. Byte offsets are canonical; line/column are derived and null when a span does not resolve.

fields.file: the file name, or null if the span's source is unknown
